description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Formlabs is hiring a Software Engineer on its Business Systems team to build and maintain production software across the company’s business platforms. The role develops integrations, automations, internal tools, and data pipelines, and supports work from requirements and design through deployment and production support.
Business Systems Software Engineer building integrations, workflow automations, and data pipelines across eCommerce, CRM, and ERP platforms

Responsibilities:
• Build and Ship: Write, test, and deploy production code in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: system integrations, workflow automations, internal tools, and extensions to platforms like Shopify, Salesforce, and NetSuite
• Learn the Landscape: Work on real projects across our portfolios (Financial Systems, Digital Systems, and Data Platform) to understand how data and transactions flow from a customer order through fulfillment, billing, and financial reporting
• Connect Systems: Build and maintain APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines that move information reliably between our eCommerce, CRM, ERP, and data warehouse
• Engineer with AI: Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex as a core part of how you work, and help build AI-supported workflows that make the business faster
• Own the Lifecycle: Take work from problem definition and requirements with business stakeholders through design, testing, CI/CD, and deployment, and support what you ship in production
• Raise the Bar: Follow and improve our engineering standards: version control, code review, automated testing, and clear documentation, so what we build is easy to maintain
• Grow Your Path: Work with your manager to identify where you can have the most impact and build depth toward a focused engineering role within Systems

Requirements:
• 0–3 years of professional software engineering experience, including internships and co-ops
• Recent graduates are strongly encouraged to apply
• Working proficiency in at least one of Python or TypeScript/JavaScript, with a grasp of core concepts like data structures, APIs, and debugging, plus a willingness to pick up the other
• A track record of learning quickly and building things, shown through internships, personal or open-source projects, hackathons, research, or coursework that went beyond the assignment
• Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) and good judgment about reviewing and verifying what they produce
• Genuine interest in how a company actually operates and a desire to understand the business problem, not just the ticket
• You take responsibility for outcomes, ask good questions, and can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical colleagues
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred:
• Experience writing SQL and working with relational databases or a data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery)
• Experience building on Node.js, REST APIs, or webhooks
• Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Familiarity with Git/GitHub workflows and CI/CD pipelines
• Exposure to business platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, or Shopify
• Prior internship or project work in IT, business systems, or internal tools
